title: Kirin Group - proposed acquisition of National Foods Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the proposed acquisition in the context of the supply of dairy products and non-alcoholic beverages. The ACCC did not reach a conclusive view on the specific market definition relevant to the proposed acquisition.
body_sections.Competition analysis: On 20 November 2007 the ACCC formed the view that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition. In forming this view, the ACCC took into account the limited overlap between the operations of National Foods and Kirin in Australia.
